controls.title: Create a user for the container (do not run as root)
controls.remediation: Add a non-root USER instruction to the image.

controls.title: Do not store secrets in Dockerfiles / image config
controls.expected: no secret-looking ENV baked into the image
controls.remediation: Inject secrets at runtime; never bake them into layers/config.

controls.title: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction to the container image
controls.remediation: Add a HEALTHCHECK to the image so orchestrators detect unhealthy containers.

controls.title: Do not expose management/SSH ports from the image
controls.expected: no SSH / management port exposed by the image
controls.remediation: Remove EXPOSE for SSH/management ports; use an out-of-band admin path.

controls.title: Configure TLS authentication for the Docker daemon socket
controls.expected: daemon requires TLS client auth (no plaintext remote API)
controls.remediation: Enable --tlsverify with a CA; never expose the API without TLS.

controls.title: Ensure a separate partition for containers has been created
controls.expected: host provisions /var/lib/docker on its own partition
controls.remediation: Provision /var/lib/docker on a dedicated partition; attest the host build.
